backend/main.mo: Actor managing user profiles and product data with access control, supporting CRUD for profiles and product definitions with metadata.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing UI styling changes, impacted files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing various frontend files, primarily TypeScript utilities and UI components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variables defining light/dark color tokens and applying global background and border styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading jsPDF/JSZip scripts and mounting the React app root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app controller handling auth, onboarding, profile setup, navigation, and view switching.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button integrating Internet Identity with accessible labels and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Opaque dialog prompting first-time users to enter a name and save their profile.
frontend/src/components/errors/GlobalErr: React error boundary displaying a fallback UI with reload option and optional dev-only error details.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: Renders a multi-tab instructional guide explaining how to edit, generate, and sell digital products. Uses cards, alerts, and tabbed sections to outline steps for usage and platform-specific selling.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Provides UI for downloading generated product PDFs and ZIPs individually or as a combined master ZIP. Handles download actions, errors, and file size formatting.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main application layout with header navigation, authentication-aware actions, and buttons for instructions, preview, export, and storefront. Wraps child views inside a styled page structure.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Displays a modal containing ExportInstructions for onboarding users. Includes close handling and a confirmation button to proceed.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Shows a PDF preview iframe if a blob is provided, otherwise displays an alert. Manages object URL lifecycle for preview rendering.
frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedP: Shows a unified preview of all default products with cover images, descriptions, and PDF previews if generated. Supports expanding descriptions and navigating back.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Previews the structure of a product’s ZIP contents, listing files and folders based on templates, checklists, and prompts. Uses a scrollable area and simple file-type icons.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Interactive editor for modifying a product's fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists with generate actions.
Manages multiple product drafts, handles loading/saving, and triggers single or bulk generation of product bundles.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Store: Displays a product card with cover, description toggle, and an edit button for storefront view.
Renders the storefront grid of default products and provides navigation back to the editor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and maintains a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, creating identities, handling login state, and persisting identity across reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Manages onboarding modal visibility and persistence using localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines react-query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light/dark modes plus utility classes for workspace visuals.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Maps product IDs to cover image paths and provides helpers to fetch cover images as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Defines default product entries with metadata, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Provides utilities to trigger browser downloads for blobs and files.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, date-stamped filenames for PDFs, ZIPs, and product bundles.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Iterates over products to generate bundles with optional progress callbacks.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Builds a full product bundle by generating its PDF, ZIP, and returning metadata.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Manages saving, loading, and resetting localStorage drafts with versioning.
Creates a multi-page PDF for a product using jsPDF, including optional cover images.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Creates a master ZIP containing all product ZIPs plus a consolidated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Builds a ZIP for a single product containing its PDF, cover, templates, checklists, prompts, and README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Generates README sections with usage guidance and upload instructions for Gumroad and Etsy.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and identity provider wrappers.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript types for product entries, modules, and generated bundles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routes), storing them in sessionStorage, and retrieving or clearing persisted values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s current build state, features, issues, and architectural notes for tracking app progress and known problems.
